id.description: Unique id of this document within the set: 'invoice', 'packing-list', 'cmr', 'contract', or a short name for another document; 'invoice-2' for a second document of a type.

sourceFile.description: Name of the file the document came from, without folders. For a document spread over several image files, the first file.

language.description: Main language of the document text. An amount in words is read in it, and a month name in a date is checked in it or in English.

number.description: The document's own number, e.g. invoice number or CMR number.

consignee.description: Delivery party, only when one is printed apart from the buyer; otherwise all values null.

contractRef.description: Contract or order the invoice refers to.

subtotal.description: Goods value before discounts and charges. Null when the invoice prints one total only.

discount.description: Discount taken off on this invoice, as an amount of money: 'Discount 5%: 775.00' becomes '775.00'. Never a percentage. Null when no amount is printed.

discountPercent.description: Discount rate in percent, when one is printed: '5%' becomes '5'. Null if none. When only the rate is printed (no amount), fill this and leave discount null.

freight.description: Freight charged ON this invoice. Null if freight is only mentioned as paid separately.

otherCharges.description: Every other amount this invoice adds between the subtotal and the total (packing, handling, bank charges, a second tax), one entry per printed amount. An amount it takes off (an advance already paid) is negative. Quote the amount with the currency printed next to it ('USD 120.00'). [] if none.

tax.description: Tax added on this invoice (VAT, GST, sales tax), as an amount: 'VAT 18%: 2,790.00' becomes '2790.00'. Quote the amount without the rate, with the currency printed next to it ('EUR 2,394.00'). Null when the prices already include the tax or only a rate is printed.

total.description: Final amount payable on this invoice.

packages.description: Number of packages stated on the invoice. Keep a packing word printed next to it in the quote: '82 cartons'.

textValue.description: The value as written in the document, on one line, or null if absent.

quote.description: Exact text copied from the document, character for character (same spelling, digits, separators and script): the text of this field only, without its label, wrapped lines joined with one space. Null when the value is null.

page.description: Page of the source file where the quote is printed, counted from 1. Null when the value is null.

dateValue.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD. '18.09.2026' becomes '2026-09-18'; day first unless the document's own dates show the month first. Null if absent.

name.description: Company or person name, with its legal form.

address.description: Street, building, postal code and city, without the country. Null when only a name and a country are printed.

country.description: Country as written in the document, also when it is the last word of the address.

taxId.description: Tax or company identification number as printed, without the label. Null when none is printed.

code.description: Incoterms rule code as written, e.g. 'FCA', 'CIF', 'EXW'.

place.description: Named place after the rule, e.g. 'Kayseri, Türkiye'.

currencyValue.description: ISO 4217 code: 'EUR', 'USD', 'GEL', 'TRY', 'RUB'… '€' becomes 'EUR', 'ლარი' becomes 'GEL'. Null if absent.

model.description: Article, model or SKU code. Null when the document prints none.

hsCode.description: HS / tariff code exactly as printed, if present.

quantity.description: Number of goods units. Quote the number alone ('400'); the unit goes in unit.

decimalValue.description: Canonical decimal: optional '-', digits, optional '.' and digits. No thousands separators, no currency, no units. '13,300.00' becomes '13300.00'; '1 880,5' becomes '1880.5'. The decimal sign is the one the same document's other numbers show: next to '9.684,00', '16.560' becomes '16560'. Keep the printed decimals. Never a sum or a conversion of your own. Null if absent.

wordsValue.description: The full amount-in-words phrase, copied exactly, including currency words. Null if absent.

id.description: Unique id of this document within the set: 'invoice', 'packing-list', 'cmr', 'contract', or a short name for another document; 'invoice-2' for a second document of a type.

sourceFile.description: Name of the file the document came from, without folders. For a document spread over several image files, the first file.

language.description: Main language of the document text. An amount in words is read in it, and a month name in a date is checked in it or in English.

number.description: The document's own number, e.g. invoice number or CMR number.

invoiceRef.description: Invoice this packing list belongs to.

packingMethod.description: Packing method printed once for the whole list, e.g. 'Packing: cartons' becomes 'cartons'. Null if none.

totalQuantity.description: Total quantity as printed. Null when the list prints no total; never a sum of the lines.

totalPackages.description: Total number of packages as printed, with a packing word printed next to it in the quote ('82 cartons'). Null when no total is printed.

totalNetWeightKg.description: Total net weight as printed. Null when no total is printed.

totalGrossWeightKg.description: Total gross weight as printed. Null when no total is printed.

totalVolumeM3.description: Total volume as printed. Null when no total is printed.

quantity.description: Number of goods units. Quote the number alone; the unit goes in unit.

packages.description: Number of packages for this line. Quote the number alone when the line prints its packing method; that goes in packingMethod.

packingMethod.description: Packing method printed for this line in its own cell, e.g. 'carton', 'pallet'. Null if none.

id.description: Unique id of this document within the set: 'invoice', 'packing-list', 'cmr', 'contract', or a short name for another document; 'invoice-2' for a second document of a type.

sourceFile.description: Name of the file the document came from, without folders. For a document spread over several image files, the first file.

language.description: Main language of the document text. An amount in words is read in it, and a month name in a date is checked in it or in English.

number.description: The consignment note number, printed in the header.

date.description: (a) Date the CMR was made out (box 21). The date in the header has no field: take it only when box 21 is empty.

placeOfIssue.description: (a) Place where the CMR was made out (box 21).

placeOfTakingOver.description: (d) Place of taking over the goods (box 4).

dateOfTakingOver.description: (d) Date of taking over the goods (box 4).

totalPackages.description: (g) Total number of packages, when printed apart from the goods lines; otherwise null.

totalGrossWeightKg.description: (h) Total gross weight, when printed apart from the goods lines; otherwise null.

carriageCharges.description: (i) Charges relating to carriage, as written.

customsInstructions.description: (j) Instructions for customs and other formalities.

convention.description: (k) Statement that the carriage is subject to the CMR Convention; quote the whole sentence.

attachedDocuments.description: Documents listed as attached (box 5), one text entry per document, as printed with its number, e.g. 'Invoice AOS-INV-2026-0918-01'.

packages.description: Number of packages (box 7). Quote the number alone; the packing word goes in packingMethod.
